item.title: Hurricane Trudy becomes major Category 3 storm near Mexico's Pacific Coast

item.title: Japan issued a 9.9 magnitude earthquake alert, but ground didn't shake: What happened
item.description: An "alert" indicating a massive magnitude-9.9 earthquake sent shockwaves of fear across Japan on Friday afternoon. Just eight minutes after its issuance, the Japan Meteorological Agency retracted the warning, which had been triggered by a lesser magnitude-6.9 quake off the Kamchatka Peninsula in Russia. Although the alert caused temporary disruptions in transportation, officials are now investigating the warning system to ensure public safety and prevent future confusion. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Iguazu Falls in South America hits record 10 times normal water flow – video
item.description: Iguazu Falls, an Unesco world heritage site, has reached a record water flow after heavy rains across the river basin. El Niño weather patterns are said to have driven the water flow to hit 10 times the normal amount. item.title: Scorecard: Colombia gets top marks while high-emitting countries doing too little to protect health from climate change
item.description: The latest Healthy NDC Scorecard, published by the Global Climate and Health Alliance, finds that, Colombia integrates health most deeply into its national climate plan, closely followed by Nigeria and Cambodia. Conversely, the climate commitments of the governments of Japan, New Zealand and India fail to adequately consider health, while high-emitting economies, including EU members, China, Brazil and the U.K., refer to health in their national climate plans but do not match this with the ambitious emissions reduction targets required to protect health. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: World Mushroom Day: From food to plastic replacement
